evidence.title: Mobbin MCP: The Design MCP Server for AI Agents

name: Mobbin MCP
summary: Design MCP server that lets AI agents search 600,000+ real app screens and UI patterns from shipped products.
description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects AI coding and design agents to Mobbin's library of 600,000+ real product screens. Agents can search and pull examples — paywalls, onboarding, KYC, checkout and signup flows, 404 pages, bottom sheets — and reason over them while designing. One-click install for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, Manus, Grok, Figma and v0; included in Mobbin's paid plans.
contains: search, reference and reason over screens and flows from an AI agent
one-click install for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, Manus, Grok, Figma and v0; no API key needed
included in all paid Mobbin plans (Pro & Team)
example outputs: paywall patterns, KYC flows, checkout comparisons, 404 pages, bottom sheets
